# Introduction

The Ashen cape is the combat focused Ashlands-tier Cape.
A more mobile Ashlands-tier cape is the Asksvin cloak focusing on dodging and running.

## Perks

The Ashen cape gives resistant against frost, -10% to attack stamina usage and -20% to block stamina usage.
